app_fee.value: Central research guidance outlines tuition fees and postgraduate funding without stating a general application fee for research degree programmes.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Exeter.

toefl_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement for Profile B2 programmes is TOEFL iBT 90 with minimum scores of 21 for writing, listening, reading and speaking.
toefl_min.quote:
TOEFL iBT, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, TOEFL iBT Paper Edition and TOEFL MyBest scores

ielts_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement for Profile B2 programmes is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and no less than 6 in any section.

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to UK nationals or nationals of majority English-speaking countries determined by the Home Office; qualifications from non-majority countries do not waive test requirements.
english_waiver.quote: English language requirements vary by programme, and our individual programme pages list the required profile for those who are not UK Nationals or who are not nationals of majority English-speaking countries determined by the Home Off
